description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class EmployeeSalaryDao in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing employee salary data, including saving, deleting, and retrieving salary records and related entities.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDao
classes.description: A DAO class extending BaseDao, managing EmployeeSalary entities with methods for CRUD operations, querying, and filtering.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeSalary entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Removes an EmpDirectDebit entity from the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeSalary records based on employee number and salary IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeSalary record by employee number and salary ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeSalaryIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns IDs of EmployeeSalary records matching provided IDs and employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Fetches a list of EmployeeSalary records based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of EmployeeSalary records matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object based on search filter parameters for paginated query results.
